mapper.select: SELECT a.instance_name AS "instance_name", TO_CHAR(h.time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "alert_time", ((h.time - TO_DATE('1970-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD')) * 86400 - (EXTRACT(TIMEZONE_HOUR FROM SYSTIMESTAMP) * 3600 + EXTRACT(TIMEZONE_MINUTE FROM SYSTIMESTAMP) * 60) ) * 1000 AS "alert_epoch", DECODE(h.type, 1, 'Server Alert', 2, 'Stat Alert', 'Type '||h.type) AS "alert_type", h.name AS "alert_name", TO_CHAR(h.value) AS "alert_value" FROM apm_db_info a JOIN ora_alarm_history h ON a.db_id = h.db_id WHERE h.sms_flag = '1' AND h.time >= TO_DATE(#{selDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND h.time < TO_DATE(#{selDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 ORDER BY h.time DESC FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY
